task.accept: M1-T8 section 10 requires administrative session HTTP 401 to direct to safe same-site login; recognized bad_credentials stays inline. Existing tasks are primitives with downstream wiring explicitly deferred.

state.conflict: Two routine implementation questions. First, true local HTTP 401 HTML response or interrupted body loses the usable error code; api-errors.ts actionFor only recognizes code unauthorized and returns stop despite preserving status 401. Second, batch record matching requires an exact task set. Recording four task IDs will honestly represent the requested scope but not mark the entire six-task batch closed in the handoff UI. No generator changes or full-batch claim are requested.

options.A: Add regression coverage and repair only admin HTTP 401 with missing or unrecognized error code to action login and safe login text, preserving recognized bad_credentials/recovery/reauth semantics and visitor behavior. Record only the four reviewed IDs in tasks frontmatter; note excluded IDs and that the six-task batch gate is unchanged.
options.B: Add the same focused 401 repair, but keep all six IDs in tasks frontmatter as batch membership and explicitly list four reviewed IDs plus two human-excluded IDs in the record body; treat the result as a batch closure under the human exclusion.
options.C: Record the reproducible 401 as an open repair task without changing the client, keeping only the four reviewed IDs in record frontmatter and preserving the full batch gate.

state.requirement: Batch 3 M5-T1 requires true PostgreSQL atomic claims, 90-second leases, correct lease ownership/generation fencing, safe read. Only repair the lease root cause, no redesign or production job wiring.

task.title: M5-T1 claim can report an already expired lease as acquired after waiting on a database lock
task.accept: Same key concurrent claim has one current winner; expired old owners cannot complete; returned acquired lease state must be current.

state.conflict: Real isolated PostgreSQL17.9 probe holds an expired JobState row lock. Waiting claim samples clock at t=90s before currentTimezoneRevision and INSERT ON CONFLICT. Clock moves to181s while SQL waits; after lock release it returns acquired=true, generation2, lockedUntil180s, view.leaseActive=true. A next worker immediately claims generation3. Existing renew/complete fence stale writes, but first worker can begin work based on a falsely active acquired result. Existing 14 DB tests pass, missing this acquisition delay case.

options.A: Keep the atomic SQL and existing interface. After the awaited claim SQL returns, sample and validate the clock again; build the returned view with that time. Return acquired=false/busy if the stored lease is already expired, do not hand out an inactive acquired lease. Preserve stored fenced row until a new worker reclaims it normally. Add a true PostgreSQL lock-wait regression proving expired claims do not acquire.
options.B: Change claim to a service-owned transaction that locks the row before sampling time, then performs conditional claim inside the same transaction. This expands the current claim interface and caller contract but can grant a full lease after contention.
options.C: Replace the injected application clock in claim with database clock_timestamp sampled after lock acquisition, redesigning deterministic clock tests and documenting cross-clock consistency with renew/complete.

options.C: Use Linux CI evidence for environment-only groups and defer only the two stale reset audit tests, while retaining tests=fail/open until that strict dedicated-DB baseline and supported standalone browser run are confirmed.

# PR #407 独立安全审查最终结论

## 结论

**SECURITY_PASS，限本报告末尾修复后文件哈希。** 一轮安全审查仅发现一个取消/超限401交错阻断，实施方已做最小根因修复，本审查员独立复验通过，没有再发现已复现的安全阻断。

原远端审查提交为 acc0543a7be3e79215c8d583407f8005730d5c3c，基线为47e979641050bf101a8bf98da30aa283bea923cb；该提交本身含已复现的问题。本轮PASS适用于尚待root提交的修复后工作树，不挪用旧head CI。root须确认实际提交包含这些修复、最终精确head的必需构建/E2E检查通过、无新未解决审查项，再按用户已经给出的管理员例外授权合并#407。此安全结论不是packjoyu-security-reviewer[bot]的APPROVED，不修改或伪造指定App门禁。

源码、门禁、任务状态与生产环境未由本审查员修改。本轮只读核对PR完整diff、上下文和证据。M1-T6/M1-T9素材不在范围。

## 唯一阻断及复验

S2：真实HTTP401返回大于4MiB的Content-Length；真实fetch拿到Response后调用方AbortController立即abort，再交回requestApi。原代码的readCapped忽略body.cancel异常并正常返回oversize，响应正文处理分支未重查caller取消，于是统一适配返回login与非空会话文案，即使signal.aborted=true。

原始探针：security407-cancel-headers-probe.mts，原始失败日志security407-cancel-headers-probe.log。原实际为action=login/status401/aborted=true/hits1，期望silent/空text，exit1。初始化两次Windows ESM导入失败是探针环境准备，不计产品缺陷；最终使用node:createRequire加载同一仓库源，真实业务复现如上。

实施方最小修复：src/lib/client/api.ts:380正文读取正常返回、attempt清理与attempts计数后，先检查options.signal?.aborted，统一返回cancelled，再进入oversize或DTO分支。未改transport、响应上限、路径/重试策略或鉴权协议。

复验：
- 原独立探针未改业务断言，修复后输出action=silent、text为空、aborted=true、hits1，exit0；security407-cancel-headers-fixed.log。
- 独立重跑 owning HTTP直接回归：
  node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern "caller cancellation after real response headers|admin 401|request bodies over" tests/client-api-foundation.http.test.ts
  9pass/0fail/0skip，security407-cancel-direct-regressions.log。
- 覆盖caller取消优先、原六种非取消401仍login、已知凭据/恢复/本人验证分支保留、admin请求体超限仍零发送/stop/status未定义、visitor仍stop。新增用例通过真实本机HTTP及真实fetch，不是固定应答替换生产入口。
- root的新增owning测试先红0pass/1fail、focused后9/9，本审查员另有原始独立红→同探针绿证据。完整HTTP44及类型/ESLint为root收尾检查，提交/合并前仍须确认其结果，不预先冒称通过。

## 其余独立验证

1. 修复这三行取消优先保护前，本审查员完整运行 owning真实HTTP suite：43pass/0fail/0skip，45.64秒；security407-http.log。因此不是只看原实施方报告；上节直接回归专门复验新增保护及相邻分支。
